title: Japan Autumn Highlights | Tokyo, Mt Fuji & Sapporo
highlights: Experience Japan’s autumn charm across Tokyo and Hokkaido, with colourful foliage, scenic mountain landscapes, peaceful parks, and seasonal experiences throughout the journey.
Discover Mount Fuji & Hakone in autumn, featuring Mount Fuji 5th Station, the Hakone Ropeway, and panoramic views of Owakudani Valley and its volcanic landscape.
Discover Hokkaido’s autumn highlights, from Jozankei Onsen and Otaru’s historic canal to Shiroi Koibito Park, Noboribetsu’s Jigokudani, Oyunuma Pond, and Lake Toya.
Enjoy a full day at Tokyo Disneyland, exploring its themed zones, popular attractions, colourful parades, and evening entertainment against the backdrop of autumn.
overview:
About the Tour:
Experience Japan’s autumn charm on a 9-day journey through Tokyo and Hokkaido, combining seasonal landscapes, cultural landmarks, scenic adventures, and leisure experiences. Begin in Tokyo with visits to the Imperial Palace, Tokyo Tower, Meiji Jingu Shrine, Tokyo Skytree, and Senso-ji Temple, surrounded by warm autumn hues. Explore Mount Fuji and Hakone, where the Fuji Five Lakes and Owakudani Valley offer striking seasonal scenery, followed by a fun-filled day at Tokyo Disneyland. Continue to Sapporo and enjoy autumn foliage at Nakajima Park, along with a relaxing sento experience and a taste of Hokkaido’s famous Snow Royal Ice Cream. Discover Sapporo’s seasonal beauty at the Hill of the Buddha, Sapporo Art Park, Hokkaido University, and Mt. Moiwa. Take day trips to Jozankei Onsen, Otaru, and Shiroi Koibito Park, followed by an exploration of Shikotsu-Toya National Park, including Jigokudani, Oyunuma Pond, Lake Toya, and Showa Shinzan. End your journey with scenic autumn memories of Japan’s cities, mountains, lakes, and traditional experiences.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Free Time to Explore
days.desc: Welcome to Tokyo! Upon arrival at Narita International Airport, get transferred to your hotel and complete the check-in process. After settling in, you can explore Tokyo at your own pace. You can visit the Imperial Palace and admire its grand architecture surrounded by landscaped grounds that take on warm autumn hues. Also, you can visit Tokyo Tower for panoramic views of the city skyline or visit the Samurai Theatre to discover Japan’s traditional samurai heritage and historic armour.

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour by Bus
days.desc: Today, head to the iconic LOVE Sculpture and board the bus to explore the city’s famous landmarks against the backdrop of autumn colours. Visit Meiji Jingu Shrine and enjoy its peaceful forested surroundings, where the seasonal foliage adds a warm touch to the setting. Continue to Tokyo Tower and Tokyo Skytree for panoramic views of Tokyo. Later, visit Senso-ji Temple and admire its traditional architecture. After the tour, return to your hotel at your own pace from Shinjuku City.

items.title: Full Day Tokyo City Tour by Bus - From LOVE Statue with Lunch

days.title: Day Trip to Mount Fuji- 5th Station & Hakone
days.desc: Set out on a scenic journey to explore Mount Fuji and the Hakone region during Japan’s autumn season. Head to the Giulio Paolini Sculpture: “Kaleidoscorpio” and board your transfer to begin your tour to Mount Fuji 5th Station. Once there, admire views of the surrounding Fuji Five Lakes and colourful autumn landscapes. Continue to Hakone and enjoy a ride on the Hakone Ropeway, offering panoramic views of the volcanic terrain of Owakudani Valley, known for its steaming sulfur springs.

days.title: Day Trip to Disneyland
days.desc: Today, get driven to Tokyo Disneyland and experience its seven themed zones surrounded by Japan’s autumn charm. Explore areas such as the nostalgic World Bazaar and futuristic Tomorrowland. Also, enjoy exciting attractions like Space Mountain, set sail on Pirates of the Caribbean, and relive classic moments at It’s a Small World. Take a break to admire the seasonal atmosphere around the park before enjoying colourful parades and evening entertainment. Later, get transferred back to your hotel.

items.title: Tokyo Disneyland Entry Tickets | Skip-the-line Admission Tickets

days.title: Fly to Hokkaido | Transfer to Sapporo | Free Time to Explore
days.desc: Check out and get transferred to the airport for your flight to New Chitose Airport. Upon arrival in Hokkaido, get driven to your hotel in Sapporo and complete the check-in process. After settling in, spend the rest of the day at leisure and experience Sapporo’s autumn charm. You can take a peaceful stroll through Nakajima Park & enjoy the seasonal foliage, unwind with a relaxing soak at a local sento, or visit Yukijirushi Parlour to try the Snow Royal Ice Cream, a popular Hokkaido dessert.

items.title: Try Snow Royal Ice Cream at Yukijirushi Parlour
items.label: Suggestion

days.title: Sapporo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, head to Sapporo TV Tower to begin your half-day sightseeing tour. Start with the Hill of the Buddha, surrounded by landscaped grounds that take on warm seasonal hues, followed by Sapporo Art Park & its creative exhibits set amid nature. Continue to Hokkaido University & enjoy a walk through its scenic campus, where autumn foliage adds colour to the surroundings. Also, take a cable car ride to the summit of Mt. Moiwa & admire panoramic views of Sapporo as the city lights begin to glow.

days.title: Day trip to Jozankei, Otaru & Shiroi Koibito Park
days.desc: In the morning, head to Sapporo TV Tower to begin your day tour and experience Hokkaido’s autumn landscapes. Start with Jozankei Onsen, a peaceful hot spring town surrounded by mountains and colourful seasonal foliage, offering a relaxing setting to unwind. Continue to Otaru, a charming port city known for its scenic canal, music box museum, and traditional glass workshops. Later, visit Shiroi Koibito Park, a chocolate-themed attraction known for its signature white chocolate cookies.

items.title: Jozankei Onsen, Otaru & Shiroi Koibito Park Day Tour, Sapporo

days.title: Day trip to Noboribetsu & Lake Toya
days.desc: Head to Sapporo TV Tower and get driven to Shikotsu-Toya National Park for a day surrounded by Hokkaido’s autumn landscapes. Begin at Noboribetsu’s Jigokudani, also known as Hell Valley, where steaming volcanic vents create a striking landscape framed by seasonal foliage. Continue to Oyunuma Pond and admire its naturally bubbling waters and volcanic surroundings. Later, visit Lake Toya, a scenic caldera lake offering views of Mount Usu and the surrounding autumn-coloured mountains.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: After check out, get transferred to New Chitose Airport for your flight back home. As your autumn journey through Hokkaido comes to an end, take with you memories of colourful foliage, scenic landscapes, relaxing onsen experiences, and the region’s charming towns and attractions.
